entry.content:
• (Cloud Datastore Emulator) Removed support for running the Datastore emulator (gcloud beta emulators datastore start) in environment with Java versions prior to 25. Users can upgrade to Java 25 or above to continue using the latest Datastore emulator. Alternatively, users can use previous gcloud CLI versions to continue using the Datastore emulator with Java 21 support.
  • (Cloud Firestore Emulator) Removed support for running the Firestore emulator (gcloud emulators firestore start) in environment with Java versions prior to 25. Users can upgrade to Java 25 or above to continue using the latest Firestore emulator. Alternatively, users can use previous gcloud CLI versions to continue using the previous Firestore emulator with Java 21 support.
  • (Docker) Removed the system Python and C compiler from the Debian-based Docker images. gcloud, gsutil and bq now always run on the bundled Python, on both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. The removed packages differ by image:
  • :latest, :slim, :debian_component_based: python3, python3-dev, python3-pip, python3-crcmod and gcc.
  • :emulators: python3 and python3-crcmod.
  • :stable: python3-dev and python3-crcmod, on linux/arm64 only.
  • (Docker) Setting CLOUDSDK_PYTHON=python3 (or CLOUDSDK_GSUTIL_PYTHON / CLOUDSDK_BQ_PYTHON) in these images now makes every gcloud, gsutil or bq call fail, because there is no python3 on PATH. Unset it to use the bundled Python.
  • (Docker) If your workflow requires a system Python, install it on top of the image, for example with apt-get install python3. This does not change which Python gcloud uses. If you need to compile C extensions, also install build-essential python3-dev.
entry.summary: Recent updates remove support for older Java versions in Datastore and Firestore emulators, requiring Java 25+. Docker images have also been updated, removing system Python and C compilers. Users should ensure their environments are compatible or adjust their workflows accordingly.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: Emulator and Docker Updates

entry.content: • Changed the Java dependency of the google-cloud-cli-datastore-emulator, google-cloud-cli-firestore-emulator, google-cloud-cli-pubsub-emulator, google-cloud-cli-app-engine-java, and google-cloud-cli-bqms deb and rpm packages from a full JDK to a headless JRE, preferring Java 25. The Datastore and Firestore emulator packages now require Java 25 or later.
entry.summary: The Google Cloud CLI has updated Java dependencies for several emulator packages, including Datastore and Firestore, to use a headless JRE and prefer Java 25. The Datastore and Firestore emulators now require Java 25 or later.
entry.title: Google Cloud CLI: CLI Emulators Update

entry.content: • Removed --scanning-state flag from gcloud agent-registry skills create and gcloud agent-registry skills update. Use --scanning-policy instead.
entry.summary: The `--scanning-state` flag has been removed from `gcloud agent-registry skills create` and `update` commands. Users should now utilize the `--scanning-policy` flag for managing skill scanning configurations.
entry.title: Agent Registry: Agent Registry: Simplified Skill Creation

entry.content:
• Updated AlloyDB Auth Proxy installation instructions in gcloud alloydb connect to v1.17.2.
  • Added --connection-pooling-authproxy-pooler-scaling-type flag to gcloud beta alloydb instances create, gcloud beta alloydb instances create-secondary, and gcloud beta alloydb instances update.
  • Promoted the following flags to GA on gcloud alloydb instances create and gcloud alloydb instances update:
  • --enable-autoscaler
  • --autoscaler-max-node-count
  • --autoscaler-cool-down-period-seconds
  • --autoscaler-target-cpu-usage
  • --autoscaler-set-schedule
  • --autoscaler-schedule-cron-exp
  • --autoscaler-schedule-duration-seconds
  • --autoscaler-schedule-time-zone
  • --autoscaler-schedule-min-node-count
  • --autoscaler-schedule-description
  • Promoted the following flags to GA on gcloud alloydb instances update:
  • --autoscaler-delete-schedule
  • --autoscaler-disable-schedule
  • --autoscaler-enable-schedule
  • Added --autoscaler-target-connections-count flag to gcloud alloydb instances create and gcloud alloydb instances update.
entry.summary: New features and improvements for AlloyDB are now available. This update includes enhanced installation instructions for the Auth Proxy, new flags for connection pooling and autoscaling configuration, and promotion of several autoscaling flags to General Availability.
entry.title: AlloyDB: AlloyDB Enhancements

entry.content:
• Updated the Java SDK to version 5.2.0 build from the open source project https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/appengine-java-standard/releases/tag/v5.2.0.
  • Added --from-image and --destination-repository flags to gcloud beta app migrate-to-run for App Engine Standard environment.
  • Updated gcloud beta app migrate-to-run --from-image to show the reason returned by the App Engine Admin API when exporting the image fails.
  • Added support for the vpc_access configuration in app.yaml to gcloud app deploy, enabling Direct VPC egress for App Engine standard environment.
entry.summary: App Engine for Java Standard gets an SDK update to 5.2.0. New flags and features for `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` improve migration and error reporting. Direct VPC egress is now supported via `vpc_access` configuration in `app.yaml`.
entry.title: App Engine: App Engine Updates

entry.content: • Added MULTI_REGIONAL choice to --scope-type flag of gcloud apphub applications create.
entry.summary: The `gcloud apphub applications create` command now includes a `MULTI_REGIONAL` option for the `--scope-type` flag, allowing for broader application scope management.
entry.title: App Hub: App Hub supports multi-regional scope

entry.content: • Fixed an issue in gcloud artifacts attachments download where attachment file names were not validated before writing to --destination.
entry.summary: An issue in `gcloud artifacts attachments download` has been resolved. Attachment file names are now validated before being written to the destination, improving security and reliability.
entry.title: Artifact Registry: Artifact Registry attachment download fixed

entry.content:
• Added --dispatch-info-output-type flag to gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways create and gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways update, and upstream dispatchInfo configuration to gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways applications create and gcloud beyondcorp security-gateways applications update to configure delegated dispatch info headers.
  • Removed gcloud beta beyondcorp app and gcloud beta beyondcorp client-connector command groups.
entry.summary: New flags have been added to BeyondCorp security gateway commands to configure delegated dispatch info headers. Additionally, deprecated beta command groups for app and client-connector have been removed.
entry.title: Beyondcorp: New BeyondCorp Features for Security Gateways

entry.content:
• Added --kms-key flag to gcloud beta biglake hive catalogs create, and --kms-key and --clear-kms-key flags to gcloud beta biglake hive catalogs update to support customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK).
  • Added --workday-api-client-client-id flag to gcloud beta biglake iceberg catalogs create and gcloud beta biglake iceberg catalogs update to support Workday OIDC authentication.
entry.summary: BigLake now supports customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for Hive catalogs via the `--kms-key` flag. Additionally, Workday OIDC authentication is now supported for Iceberg catalogs using the `--workday-api-client-client-id` flag.
entry.title: BigLake: BigLake Enhancements for Encryption and Authentication

entry.content:
• Removed default value (-) for --location flag in gcloud beta backup-dr applied-auto-protection-policies list. --location flag is now required.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr applied-auto-protection-policies to GA.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud backup-dr backup-plans update --backup-rules-from-file failed with update mask is required when the file contained an empty backup-rules list.
  • Fixed an issue where gcloud backup-dr backup-plans update --backup-rules-from-file cleared --compute-instance-properties and --disk-properties when they were specified in the same command.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr applied-auto-protection-policies to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr auto-protection-bindings to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr auto-protection-policies commands to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud backup-dr binding-matching-resources to GA.
entry.summary: Several Backup and DR gcloud commands, including those for applied auto-protection policies and auto-protection bindings, are now generally available. Updates have also been made to the `--location` flag requirement for listing applied auto-protection policies and fixes have been implemented for backup plan updates.
entry.title: Cloud Backup DR: Backup and DR commands now generally available

entry.content:
• Added --automated-backup-keep-hot-duration flag to gcloud bigtable instances tables create, gcloud bigtable instances tables update, gcloud bigtable tables create, and gcloud bigtable tables update to create hot automated backups that remain hot for the specified duration before transitioning to standard backups.
  • Added --clear-automated-backup-keep-hot-duration flag to gcloud bigtable instances tables update and gcloud bigtable tables update to stop creating hot automated backups.
  • Added --avro-schema-path flag to gcloud bigtable schema-bundles create and gcloud bigtable schema-bundles update.
entry.summary: New flags allow you to create automated backups for Cloud Bigtable that remain hot for a specified duration. You can now control the hot backup duration and stop creating hot backups altogether with the new flags added to the gcloud command-line tool.
entry.title: Cloud Bigtable: Automated backups for Cloud Bigtable

entry.content:
• Added --custom-instructions flag to gcloud dataplex datascans create data-documentation and --custom-instructions and --clear-custom-instructions flags to gcloud dataplex datascans update data-documentation to support specifying or clearing custom instructions that guide data documentation generation.
  • Added --sql-dialect flag to gcloud dataplex datascans create data-documentation and gcloud dataplex datascans update data-documentation commands to specify the SQL dialect to use in generated SQL queries.
entry.summary: New flags for data documentation generation in Dataplex allow users to specify custom instructions and SQL dialects. These enhancements provide greater control over how data documentation is created, ensuring more tailored and accurate results.
entry.title: Cloud Dataplex: Dataplex data documentation improvements

entry.content: • Added --scheduling-timeout and --requested-run-duration flags to gcloud dataproc clusters create for creating Dynamic Workload Scheduler (DWS) scheduled clusters.
entry.summary: Create Dataproc clusters for Dynamic Workload Scheduler (DWS) with new flags for scheduling timeouts and requested run durations. These flags allow for more precise control over DWS scheduled cluster lifecycles.
entry.title: Cloud Dataproc: Dataproc DWS Scheduled Clusters

entry.content: • Fixed an issue where gcloud datastream private-connections create silently dropped user-supplied --labels.
entry.summary: An issue with the `gcloud datastream private-connections create` command has been resolved. Previously, user-supplied labels were silently dropped, but this is now fixed. This ensures that labels provided during private connection creation are correctly applied.
entry.title: Cloud Datastream: Datastream private connections labels fixed

entry.content:
• Release Cloud Firestore emulator v1.23.0
  • Added support for Datastore merge join and multiple inequality index selection with --require-indexes in Datastore mode
  • Added support for the add_window_fields stage in the Firestore Pipelines API with the sum, average, count, minimum, maximum, first, last, array_agg, array_agg_distinct, and rank window functions
  • Allowed Enterprise data types for all database editions
  • Fixed transaction conflict detection for concurrent writes against transactional queries
  • Fixed ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException on incomplete Firestore Rules permission traces
  • Populated accurate MoreResultsType for Datastore mode queries and fixed Pipeline DML edge cases
  • Updated minimum required Java JRE version to 25
entry.summary: The latest version of the Firestore emulator, v1.23.0, brings enhanced support for Datastore operations including merge join and multiple inequality index selection. It also introduces new capabilities for the Firestore Pipelines API with various window functions and enables Enterprise data types across all database editions. Several bug fixes have also been implemented, including improvements to transaction conflict detection and pipeline DML edge cases.
entry.title: Cloud Firestore Emulator: Firestore Emulator v1.23.0 Released

entry.content: • Updated gcloud infra-manager deployments apply to display a warning when --tf-version-constraint or the deployment configuration specifies a paid Terraform version (1.6.0 or later).
entry.summary: The `gcloud infra-manager deployments apply` command now warns users if a paid Terraform version (1.6.0+) is specified in the deployment configuration or via the `--tf-version-constraint` flag. This ensures users are aware of potential costs associated with newer Terraform features.
entry.title: Cloud Infrastructure Manager: Terraform Paid Version Warning

entry.content: • Added support for ECDH key encapsulation mechanism algorithms: kem-ecdh-p256 and kem-ecdh-p384.
entry.summary: Cloud Key Management Service now supports ECDH key encapsulation mechanisms, including `kem-ecdh-p256` and `kem-ecdh-p384`. This enhancement provides more options for securing your data with advanced cryptographic algorithms.
entry.title: Cloud Key Management Service: New Key Encapsulation Algorithms Supported

entry.content: • Added --public flag for Cloud Run services, allowing users to make a service public by disabling invoker IAM checks and Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP). This flag is available in gcloud beta run deploy, gcloud beta run services update, and gcloud beta run multi-region-services update.
entry.summary: You can now easily make Cloud Run services public with the new --public flag. This flag disables invoker IAM checks and Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP), simplifying access for public-facing applications. The feature is available in the gcloud beta command-line interface.
entry.title: Cloud Run: Cloud Run: Make Services Public

entry.content: • Added gcloud sql instances reconcile-networking to reconcile Private Service Connect (PSC) DNS networking configuration for a Cloud SQL instance.
entry.summary: A new command, `gcloud sql instances reconcile-networking`, is now available to help manage Private Service Connect (PSC) DNS networking configurations for your Cloud SQL instances. This simplifies the process of ensuring your instance's networking is correctly set up.
entry.title: Cloud SQL: Simplify Cloud SQL networking

entry.content:
• Updated gcloud cloud-shell scp to support passwordless authentication over the Cloud Shell TCP tunnel.
  • Updated gcloud cloud-shell ssh to skip uploading an SSH public key when connecting with passwordless authentication.
entry.summary: Cloud Shell now supports passwordless authentication for secure file transfers using `gcloud cloud-shell scp` over TCP tunnels. It also streamlines SSH connections by skipping public key uploads when using passwordless authentication.
entry.title: Cloud Shell: Cloud Shell improves secure file transfers

entry.content:
• Added --direct-access-ports flag to gcloud beta workstations clusters create command.
  • Added --direct-access-ports flag to gcloud beta workstations clusters update command.
entry.summary: New flags `--direct-access-ports` have been added to `gcloud beta workstations clusters create` and `update` commands. This allows for direct access to specific ports for Cloud Workstations clusters, enhancing connectivity options.
entry.title: Cloud Workstations: Cloud Workstations: Direct Access Ports Enabled

entry.content:
• Fixed an issue where gcloud compute commands omitted troubleshooting documentation links from operation error messages.
  • Promoted --reservation-subblock flag of gcloud compute hosts describe, gcloud compute hosts list, gcloud compute reservations hosts describe, and gcloud compute reservations hosts list to GA and beta.
entry.summary: Resolved an issue with gcloud compute commands not showing troubleshooting links in error messages. Additionally, the `--reservation-subblock` flag for hosts has been promoted to General Availability and Beta.
entry.title: Compute Engine: Compute Engine improvements

entry.content: • Deprecated gcloud firebase test command group. Firebase Test Lab is deprecated and will be fully shut down on September 30, 2027. To maintain your testing workflows, you can migrate to the Developer Device Platform on Google Cloud. See the Developer Device Platform Migration Guide (https://docs.cloud.google.com/developer-device-platform/device-run/migrate) and FAQ (https://docs.cloud.google.com/developer-device-platform/troubleshooting) for more details.
entry.summary: Firebase Test Lab is being deprecated and will shut down on September 30, 2027. Migrate your testing workflows to the Developer Device Platform on Google Cloud to ensure continuity. Detailed migration guides and FAQs are available.
entry.title: Firebase Test Lab: Firebase Test Lab Deprecation

entry.content:
• Added --enable-dataplane-v2 flag to gcloud container clusters update to initiate GKE Dataplane V2 migration for clusters.
  • Added --datapath-provider flag to gcloud container node-pools update to update the datapath provider for a node pool.
  • Promoted --enable-ambient-networking flag to GA for gcloud container clusters create, gcloud container clusters create-auto, and gcloud container clusters update.
entry.summary: GKE now supports migrating to Dataplane V2 using the `gcloud container clusters update --enable-dataplane-v2` flag. Additionally, ambient networking, a feature for enhanced network management, has been promoted to General Availability.
entry.title: Kubernetes Engine: GKE Dataplane V2 and Ambient Networking Updates

entry.content:
• Updated SecurityProfile and SecurityProfileGroup YAML schemas to support WildFire Analysis in beta and GA.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: New versions of SecurityProfile and SecurityProfileGroup YAML schemas now support WildFire Analysis, with beta and general availability features. This update enhances network security capabilities by integrating advanced threat analysis.
entry.title: Network Security: WildFire Analysis Support for Security Profiles
